# Job Description - Associate Enterprise Architect

> **Position**: Associate Enterprise Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an Associate Enterprise Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This entry-level role will learn and support the creation and enforcement of our Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) for Gainwell Technologies' product portfolio and assist in tactical architecture activities under the guidance of senior team members.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#primary-duties]

### Primary Duties

- Learn and support the Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) framework and principles
- Assist in research and documentation activities across architecture domains
- Support evaluation of technologies and software products under senior architect guidance
- Participate in architecture training and professional development programs
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#architecture--design-support]

### Architecture & Design Support

- Support design activities for technology solutions under senior architect supervision
- Assist in creating technical documentation and architecture artifacts
- Learn architecture patterns and standards that guide technology solution design
- Support cloud implementation activities on AWS and Azure platforms
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#collaboration--learning]

### Collaboration & Learning

- Participate in team meetings and Architecture Review Board (ARB) sessions as observer
- Support collaboration activities with development teams and stakeholders
- Assist in preparing technical content and documentation
- Learn from experienced architects through mentoring and shadowing
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#documentation--research]

### Documentation & Research

- Create and maintain technical documentation under guidance
- Research industry best practices and emerging technologies
- Support knowledge management initiatives within the Enterprise Architecture Practice
- Assist in documenting technical processes and procedures
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#training--development]

### Training & Development

- Participate in architecture governance training and processes
- Learn healthcare regulations including HIPAA, MITA, and FedRAMP requirements
- Develop understanding of enterprise architecture principles and methodologies
- Build technical skills through hands-on projects and assignments

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Recent graduate or within 2 years of graduation
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 0-3 years of experience in software development, IT, or related technical field
- **Preferred**: Internship or project experience in enterprise environments
- **Preferred**: Basic exposure to healthcare technology or government systems
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#core-technical-skills]

#### Core Technical Skills

- Basic understanding of software development principles and methodologies
- Familiarity with technical documentation tools (Markdown, Mermaid, basic diagramming tools)
- Understanding of software development lifecycle concepts
- Basic knowledge of system design principles
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#technology-foundation]

#### Technology Foundation

- Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) concepts
- Familiarity with APIs and integration concepts
- Basic database and data management knowledge
- Understanding of enterprise software applications
- Programming experience in one or more languages (Java, C#, Python, etc.)
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#learning--development]

#### Learning & Development

- Strong learning agility and curiosity about technology
- Basic understanding of software architecture patterns
- Willingness to learn DevOps practices and CI/CD concepts
- Interest in enterprise architecture principles
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Familiarity with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)
- Basic experience with Generative AI tools for learning and problem-solving
- Interest in AI agents and automation tools for development workflows
page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Cloud Practitioner or Azure Fundamentals
- Programming or technology-related certifications

---
page_texts.21:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#academic-background]

### Academic Background

- Coursework in systems analysis, software architecture, or enterprise systems
- Projects involving enterprise software development or integration
- Academic research in relevant technology areas
- Participation in technology-related extracurricular activities
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#technical-interest-areas]

### Technical Interest Areas

- Interest in healthcare technology and compliance requirements
- Curiosity about government systems and public sector technology
- Understanding of security principles and best practices
- Interest in enterprise data management concepts
- Exposure to or interest in Generative AI technologies and their business applications
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#professional-skills]

### Professional Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in team environments
- Self-motivated with strong learning orientation

---
page_texts.25:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#learning--growth]

### Learning & Growth

- **Learning Agility**: Ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
- **Curiosity**: Strong interest in understanding how enterprise systems work
- **Adaptability**: Flexibility to work on various types of projects and technologies
- **Growth Mindset**: Commitment to continuous learning and professional development
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#technical-foundation]

### Technical Foundation

- **Systems Thinking**: Basic ability to understand system relationships
- **Problem Solving**: Analytical approach to technical challenges
- **Technical Communication**: Ability to discuss technical concepts clearly
- **Attention to Detail**: Careful approach to documentation and analysis
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#collaboration-skills]

### Collaboration Skills

- **Teamwork**: Strong collaboration and team participation abilities
- **Communication**: Clear verbal and written communication skills
- **Initiative**: Proactive approach to learning and contributing
- **Professionalism**: Professional demeanor and work ethic

---
page_texts.29:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#training--mentorship]

### Training & Mentorship

- Structured onboarding program with senior architect mentorship
- Access to enterprise architecture training and certification programs
- Participation in internal and external training opportunities
- Career development planning and guidance
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#project-exposure]

### Project Exposure

- Rotation through different architecture domains and project types
- Exposure to various technologies and platforms
- Participation in architecture governance processes
- Collaboration with cross-functional teams
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/associate-enterprise-architect.md#professional-growth]

### Professional Growth

- Clear career progression path within the Enterprise Architecture Practice
- Opportunities to attend conferences and industry events
- Certification support and professional development budget
- Networking opportunities with industry professionals

---
